meta.name: Ensure that Application Gateway uses WAF in "Detection" or "Prevention" modes
meta.description: Ensure that Application Gateway uses WAF in "Detection" or "Prevention" modes

evaluators.description: A policy_settings block, when present, must have enabled truthy. policy_settings is a MaxItems-1 block, so the plan path is policy_settings.0.enabled; the deny-list form fails on an explicit false while passing on true or null. error_tolerance is 2 because an omitted policy_settings block leaves the path unresolvable (a severity-2 miss over an empty list), which is not a violation.
